notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome120/chrome124) + requests, no browser needed. robots.txt allows ClaudeBot (Allow: / with only Disallow: /*+*), so all tiers permitted. A few individual product-listing pages returned transient 403s on first pass and succeeded on retry with a short delay (site has light rate-limiting, not a hard block). TREE: Built from (1) the full mega-menu embedded in the homepage HTML (data-nav-category/subcategory/label attributes, 207 leaf entries covering Lighting/Furniture/Outdoor/Fans/Decor/Shop By/Sale), (2) sitemap_2-category.xml (2187 category URLs) for candidate discovery, and (3) each candidate page's own 'Featured Filters' strip (data-facet-source=THN|FEATURED) to confirm true parent/child decomposition by checking whether children's counts sum to the parent's count. This decomposition check was decisive: e.g. /office-shelving/ (241) = Bookcases(198)+WallShelves(43) exactly -> both children are Furniture/Wall Decor, so nothing from that node qualifies as Storage despite the 'Shelving & Storage' nav label; /storage-cabinets/ (420) and /storage-carts/ (57) sampled product titles are Sideboards/Media Consoles/Armoires/Credenzas and Bar Carts/Bar Trolleys respectively (Furniture case-goods / serving furniture per storage.md Sec.20 and Sec.21) despite the 'storage' URL slugs, so both excluded. QTY: taken from the rendered 'N Results' counter on each listing page (also cross-checked against the page's embedded JSON 'total' field, which matched exactly in every case) - evidence string quotes this. EXCLUDED (Storage, site names it 'storage' but content is Furniture/other-category per rules): /storage-cabinets/ (420, sideboards/media consoles/armoires - Furniture), /storage-carts/ (57, bar carts/trolleys - serving furniture, storage.md Sec.20 explicit exclusion), /outdoor-storage-carts-and-trolleys/ (20, outdoor bar carts - same reason), /living-room-shelving-and-storage/, /dining-room-and-kitchen-shelving-and-storage/, /dining-room-and-kitchen-storage/, /office-shelving/ (all decompose entirely into Bookcases/Sideboards/Credenzas/Wall Shelves - Furniture or Wall Decor, zero genuine Storage content), /file-cabinets/ and /medicine-cabinets/ (both explicitly under Furniture>Office and Furniture>Bathroom in the site's own top nav - rule prefers Furniture when site places it there), /wine-racks/ (kitchen/bar accessory domain, out of scope for this task), /storage-beds/ (a bed - Furniture), /desk-and-office-accessories/ parent minus its Office Organizing child (Office Furnishings=3 and Office Wall Art=383 children are not storage), /home-organizing/, /organizational-storage/, /storage-styled/ (all off-nav curated/editorial cross-category collections with heavy product overlap with already-counted categories - treated as Collections/promotional pages per rule Sec.35). EXCLUDED (Textile): /rug-pads-and-accessories/ (functional rug-pad hardware, not the textile product itself, same spirit as excluding curtain hardware); no Curtains/Drapes category exists anywhere on the site (confirmed absent via mega-menu + sitemap keyword scan) - Lumens (primarily a lighting/furniture retailer) does not sell curtains. Grouping rows used only where a parent page's own count was confirmed (by count-sum match) to be a pure aggregate of its listed children: Rugs (Area Rugs+Runner Rugs+Floor Mats+Doormats), Pillows & Throws (Pillows+Throws), Placemats & Table Runners (Table Placemats+Table Runners) - in each case the parent's own row was dropped per the parent-URL rule and only the children recorded.
